headlines: SMALL CRAFT ADVISORY IN EFFECT THROUGH TUESDAY AFTERNOON

periods.name: Rest of tonight
periods.text: Northwest winds 15 to 20 knots becoming north. Mostly clear. Waves 2 to 4 feet subsiding to 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Tuesday
periods.text: North winds 5 to 15 knots becoming northeast. Sunny. Waves 1 to 3 feet subsiding to 1 foot or less.

periods.name: Tuesday night
periods.text: Northeast winds 5 to 15 knots becoming east. Partly cloudy in the evening, then becoming mostly cloudy. Waves 1 to 3 feet.

periods.name: Wednesday
periods.text: East winds 10 to 15 knots increasing to 15 to 20 knots. Mostly cloudy in the morning, then becoming mostly sunny. Waves 1 to 3 feet building to 2 to 4 feet.

notes: See Lake Erie open lakes forecast for Thursday through Saturday.
The water temperature off Toledo is 52 degrees, off Cleveland 54 degrees, and off Erie 51 degrees.
